title: Fixed presentation transport of the recorded intrinsic reduction comparison
statement: Let $R,S$ be finite commutative unital rings and $\psi:R\to S$ a unital homomorphism. For schemes $X,Y$ and a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow qY)$, use the ordinary intrinsic constant-ring module derived categories and their fixed-module realization [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], with the actual geometric operations and adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and sectionwise sheafified open extension [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Write $E_{T,R}$ for the canonical realization equivalence from fixed modules over the universe lift of $R$ to intrinsic modules, $T_T$ for intrinsic scalar extension [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], $\widehat T_T$ for the fixed scalar left adjoint to actual restriction [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility], $F_R=Rq_*j_!$ for intrinsic support [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison], and $\widehat F_R$ for its fixed-module presentation [def-sfb-finite-derived-lower-shriek-compactification]. The scalar comparison $s_T:E_{T,R}T_T\simeq\widehat T_TE_{T,S}$ is the left-adjoint uniqueness comparison whose right-adjoint comparison is the derived sectionwise identity between realization and scalar restriction [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. The support comparison $a_R:E_{X,R}F_R\simeq\widehat F_RE_{Y,R}$ cancels the realization unit for open extension and then uses the canonical direct-image presentation comparison. For the latter, first identify the tensor-coefficient and sectionwise direct-image models by right-adjoint uniqueness using the unique pullback isomorphism preserving sectionwise units [lem-trf-open-square-exchange], then derive and use the K-injective-normalized realization comparison [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For every natural transformation $b:F_RT_Y\to T_XF_S$, define its transport $\widehat b:\widehat F_R\widehat T_Y\to\widehat T_X\widehat F_S$ as the fully faithful preimage under postcomposition with $E_{Y,S}$ of the composite $\widehat F_R\widehat T_YE_{Y,S}\xrightarrow{\widehat F_Rs_Y^{-1}}\widehat F_RE_{Y,R}T_Y\xrightarrow{a_R^{-1}T_Y}E_{X,R}F_RT_Y\xrightarrow{E_{X,R}b}E_{X,R}T_XF_S\xrightarrow{s_XF_S}\widehat T_XE_{X,S}F_S\xrightarrow{\widehat T_Xa_S}\widehat T_X\widehat F_SE_{Y,S}$. All comparison data are the specified normalized constructions, and $b$ is used as the middle morphism.
